key: A new schedule is a separate arrangement; it does not change this task or its current work.
en: A new schedule is a separate arrangement; it does not change this task or its current work.
zh_cn: 新计划是独立安排，不会修改此任务或正在执行的工作。

key: A scheduled occurrence is a trigger, not a guaranteed start time. Current task state and available resources still apply.
en: A scheduled occurrence is a trigger, not a guaranteed start time. Current task state and available resources still apply.
zh_cn: 计划时间表示触发时间，不保证立即开始；执行仍取决于任务状态和可用资源。

key: Approval could not be confirmed. Checking its current state. Your draft is kept.
en: Approval could not be confirmed. Checking its current state. Your draft is kept.
zh_cn: 尚未确认审批结果，正在检查当前状态。草稿已保留。

key: Completes when its work finishes successfully, unless Ghost explicitly continues it.
en: Completes when its work finishes successfully, unless Ghost explicitly continues it.
zh_cn: 工作成功结束后完成，除非 Ghost 明确继续此任务。

key: Connect a ready model before sending. Your draft can stay here.
en: Connect a ready model before sending. Your draft can stay here.
zh_cn: 请先连接可用模型再发送。草稿会保留在这里。

key: Connection lost. Reconnecting… Your draft is kept.
en: Connection lost. Reconnecting… Your draft is kept.
zh_cn: 连接已断开，正在重连…草稿已保留。

key: Describe what you have in mind…
en: Describe what you have in mind…
zh_cn: 发消息，或交给 Ghost 一件事…

key: Disabling stops future triggers. Work already admitted keeps its frozen instructions; this does not pause or cancel the linked task.
en: Disabling stops future triggers. Work already admitted keeps its frozen instructions; this does not pause or cancel the linked task.
zh_cn: 停用后不再产生后续触发；已接收的工作保留冻结指令，不会因此暂停或取消关联任务。

key: Execution updates are temporarily unavailable. Retrying…
en: Execution updates are temporarily unavailable. Retrying…
zh_cn: 执行信息暂时不可用，正在重试…

key: Find a task by title or goal
en: Find a task by title or goal
zh_cn: 按标题或目标查找任务

key: Finishing a work session keeps this task open. Further work needs a new instruction or a configured trigger.
en: Finishing a work session keeps this task open. Further work needs a new instruction or a configured trigger.
zh_cn: 一轮工作结束后，任务仍保持开启；后续工作需要新指令或已配置的触发条件。

key: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, weekday. Uses the time zone below.
en: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, weekday. Uses the time zone below.
zh_cn: 五个字段依次为：分钟、小时、日期、月份、星期；使用下方时区。

key: Months without this date are skipped.
en: Months without this date are skipped.
zh_cn: 没有此日期的月份将跳过。
在对话中查看更多审批

key: No automatic schedule is configured for this task.
en: No automatic schedule is configured for this task.
zh_cn: 此任务未配置自动执行计划。

key: No result has been delivered for this run yet.
en: No result has been delivered for this run yet.

zh_cn: 暂无需要你处理的事项
数值进入以下阈值时通知

key: Open attention items in a new tab
en: Open attention items in a new tab

key: Optional integer threshold. Leave blank for ordinary scheduling; zero is a valid threshold. Editing a schedule stops observations from older schedule versions from notifying.
en: Optional integer threshold. Leave blank for ordinary scheduling; zero is a valid threshold. Editing a schedule stops observations from older schedule versions from notifying.
zh_cn: 可选的整数阈值；普通计划请留空，0 也是有效值。编辑计划后，旧版本计划的观测不再触发通知。
重新加载已保存的计划

key: Reviewing a result does not approve external actions. Ghost will consider your feedback before continuing.
en: Reviewing a result does not approve external actions. Ghost will consider your feedback before continuing.
zh_cn: 审阅成果不代表批准外部动作。Ghost 会先理解你的意见，再决定如何继续。
运行中 / 排队中 / 等待中

key: Saving configures future triggers only. It does not run the task now or rewrite instructions for work already admitted.
en: Saving configures future triggers only. It does not run the task now or rewrite instructions for work already admitted.
zh_cn: 保存只配置后续触发，不会立即执行任务，也不会改写已接收工作的指令。

key: Schedule details are unavailable because the original scheduling context was revoked.
en: Schedule details are unavailable because the original scheduling context was revoked.
zh_cn: 原始计划上下文已撤销，无法显示计划详情。

key: Showing the 20 most recent instructions. Earlier additions remain in request and milestone history.
en: Showing the 20 most recent instructions. Earlier additions remain in request and milestone history.
zh_cn: 显示最近 20 条指令；更早的补充内容保留在请求与里程碑历史中。

key: Some attention items are temporarily unavailable. The items below are still current.
en: Some attention items are temporarily unavailable. The items below are still current.
zh_cn: 部分待办暂时无法读取，以下事项仍为当前待办。

key: The original objective and completion rule are fixed for this task. Create a new task to use a different completion rule.
en: The original objective and completion rule are fixed for this task. Create a new task to use a different completion rule.
zh_cn: 此任务的原始目标和完成规则已固定；如需不同的完成规则，请创建新任务。

key: The request changed while your response was being sent. Your draft is kept; check the conversation before retrying.
en: The request changed while your response was being sent. Your draft is kept; check the conversation before retrying.
zh_cn: 发送回答时问题已变更。草稿已保留，请先核对对话后再决定是否重试。

key: This answer is too long or invalid. Edit it before sending again.
en: This answer is too long or invalid. Edit it before sending again.
zh_cn: 回答过长或无效，请修改后再发送。

key: This answer is too long. Shorten it before sending.
en: This answer is too long. Shorten it before sending.
zh_cn: 回答过长，请缩短后再发送。

key: This is a page of current items, not a total count.
en: This is a page of current items, not a total count.
zh_cn: 这里显示一页当前待办，并非全部待办的总数。

key: This question or review changed. Your draft is kept for reference and has not been submitted.
en: This question or review changed. Your draft is kept for reference and has not been submitted.
zh_cn: 问题或审阅已变更。草稿已保留供你参考，尚未提交。

key: This run did not finish. Open task configuration to review the task.
en: This run did not finish. Open task configuration to review the task.
zh_cn: 本轮未完成，可在任务配置中查看任务。

key: This run is queued. Results will appear here when delivered.
en: This run is queued. Results will appear here when delivered.
zh_cn: 本轮正在排队，交付后将在这里显示结果。

key: This run is waiting. Open task configuration to review any required action.
en: This run is waiting. Open task configuration to review any required action.
zh_cn: 本轮正在等待，可在任务配置中查看需要处理的事项。

key: This run was cancelled. No result has been delivered.
en: This run was cancelled. No result has been delivered.
zh_cn: 本轮已取消，尚无交付结果。

key: Updates paused. Your draft is kept.
en: Updates paused. Your draft is kept.
zh_cn: 更新已暂停，草稿已保留。

key: Use an IANA time zone. One-time times during a clock change must identify one unambiguous instant.
en: Use an IANA time zone. One-time times during a clock change must identify one unambiguous instant.
zh_cn: 请使用 IANA 时区；单次计划在夏令时切换期间必须对应唯一的有效时间。

key: What would you like to work on?
en: What would you like to work on?

key: Work is in progress. Updates will appear here when delivered.
en: Work is in progress. Updates will appear here when delivered.
zh_cn: 任务正在执行，交付后的更新会显示在这里。

key: Your access changed. Sign in again before sending. Your draft is kept.
en: Your access changed. Sign in again before sending. Your draft is kept.
zh_cn: 访问权限已变更，请重新登录后再发送。草稿已保留。

key: Your answer goes to Ghost in the conversation. It does not directly restart the task.
en: Your answer goes to Ghost in the conversation. It does not directly restart the task.
zh_cn: 回答会送达对话中的 Ghost，不会直接重新启动任务。

key: Your response was not confirmed. Checking the current request. Your draft is kept.
en: Your response was not confirmed. Checking the current request. Your draft is kept.
zh_cn: 尚未确认回答已保存，正在核对当前问题。草稿已保留。

key: Your response was not saved. Review the current request before trying again.
en: Your response was not saved. Review the current request before trying again.
zh_cn: 回答尚未保存。请先核对当前问题，再决定是否重试。

key: Your response was saved. Ghost will review it in the conversation.
en: Your response was saved. Ghost will review it in the conversation.
zh_cn: 回答已保存，Ghost 会在对话中处理。
